filingFailedMessage: Your case could not be filed. Please try again.
successSubtitle: Your case has been submitted. An AI judge will issue an initial ruling; you'll be able to track its status and appeal from the Courts tab.
title: File a Case
subtitle: Cases are first reviewed by an AI judge. Rulings may be appealed to a citizen jury.
proofRequiredNote: Law Challenge, Treasury Dispute, and Tier Conflict cases file anonymously and require an on-device ZK proof — coming soon, not yet available.
nullifierHint: Raw 32-byte identity nullifier of the citizen this case concerns. There's no in-app lookup from an account address to a nullifier yet — this must be supplied directly.
suspensionPlaceholder: Leave blank for no specific request
suspensionAccessibilityLabel: Requested suspension length in blocks, optional
